comments: Scaled by height to 136 px, the drawing is 72 px wide (the slot says 64: about 12 percent too wide). The canvas is 72x136 at its bottom-centre anchor, so nothing is scaled to fit and the slot's box is spilled by four pixels a side (the pole has no hitbox).
geometry: No hitbox. The hub pole: eight peg slots hold the banners; art fills them, rules decide which are up. The canvas is eight pixels wider than the slot (64x136) so the painted pole is not scaled.
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crop, 2026-10-18. One drawing: a timber mast with a brass ball, two iron bands, a stone footing and four levels of mirrored peg arms (the top one the yard).
size_basis: native canvas 72x136, anchor bottom-centre (36,136); stage 384x224 at 16 px per tile; a knight is 12x20.
timing: idle 1 ticks (30 Hz). Durations are the rules' and live in assets/bannerpeak/slots.json.
